task: Real GPT-2 layer-0 GELU FFN source graph extraction

blackBoxBoundary.source: compact source manifest extracted from real GPT-2 layer-0 FFN weights
blackBoxBoundary.note: This gate verifies exact source graph extraction when source weights or equivalent hooks are available. It is intentionally separate from output-only black-box recovery.

claimScope.provesIfPasses: GCL can build and validate an exact explicit GELU source graph for a real GPT-2 FFN output slice from an instrumented source manifest, then map every atom to exact GPT-2 channel ids/layers/indices with strict provenance.
claimScope.doesNotClaim: output-only original-neuron identity, blind full-FFN decompilation, arbitrary 3072-channel GPT-2 extraction, tokenizer/model execution, or broad SOTA status.

provenance.claim: Recovered GELU atoms are matched to instrumented source neuron groups with strict parameter-error checks. Duplicate/split source neurons are reported as groups, not hallucinated as a unique single original neuron.

matches.sourceOrigin: real GPT-2 layer 0 FFN expansion channel 1614 feeding output channel 0

whyReacts.responseRule: This source group reacts when the input projection along its weight direction pushes preactivation into the GELU transition/positive region; its signed output weight controls whether the channel raises or lowers the FFN output.
